transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Thanks. Well, I guess what finally made me call the employee assistance program is that I’m just barely sleeping right lately. I go to bed and just lie there... replaying stuff from work, or arguments I've had at home. Then I end up waking up around 3 or 4 in the morning. By the time I actually have to get up and start the day, I just feel like I never really rested at all.
Aside from the sleep difficulties, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless lately?

Yeah, I have. Most days, it just feels like this heavy, gray mood follows me around. It goes with me from the office, to the car, and back to the house. Even when nothing specific is happening, I just feel kind of hollow.
About how long have you been feeling this heavy, gray mood?
I'd say it's been going on for about a year and two months now. It started right around the time the arguments at home started getting a lot worse.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in activities and hobbies you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to things like playing pickup basketball, bowling nights, or going to music festivals. I also loved firing up the smoker and having friends over. But lately... I don't know, I either end up canceling on people, or if I do show up, I just feel like I'm going through the motions. I'm not really getting anything out of it anymore.
How have your energy levels been lately?

My energy levels? Um... I guess I haven't really noticed a huge change there. I mean, I'm still getting up and going to work and doing what I need to do. I wouldn't say I feel completely wiped out or anything. It's more just... not wanting to do things, rather than not having the energy for them, if that makes sense.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over this past year?

Yeah, it has. My appetite has been off for a few months now. I'll mostly just run on coffee straight through lunch at work, and then... I don't know, I just kind of pick at dinner with my family. But the weird thing is, I realized recently that my belt is actually sitting a notch tighter than it used to. So I guess my weight has gone up a bit, even with me not eating as much.
Have you been struggling with feeling down on yourself, or experiencing excessive feelings of guilt?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep replaying things in my head lately. Every late night I've stayed at work, every tailgate I went to, or even just dumb purchases I've made over the years. It all just kind of plays on a loop. And I just end up thinking that my wife and kids got stuck with a selfish guy. I just feel like I keep letting them down.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or focusing on things lately?

Yeah, definitely. It's been pretty frustrating at work. I used to be able to just knock out sales forecasts and put together client decks without much trouble, pretty quickly. But lately... I don't know, I'll find myself reading the exact same slide four or five times. And then I just sit there and second-guess every single number I put down. It takes me forever just to decide what to say or how to present it. It's like my brain just won't lock in on what I'm supposed to be doing.
With everything feeling so heavy, have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts of wanting to hurt yourself?

No, I haven't been making any plans to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do have these thoughts sometimes. More often than I really want to admit, honestly. I'll just catch myself thinking that maybe everyone would be better off if I just didn't wake up one morning. Just... went to sleep and that was it. But I wouldn't actually do anything to make that happen.
Have you ever had a period where you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?
No, I've never had anything like that. I've never felt wired or... unusually energetic. Honestly, I'm just tired most of the time.
